effective_rule: Applications submitted after January 1, 2027 must have a passing score on an examination approved by the Massachusetts Board of Registration of Massage Therapy.
scope: State-level massage therapist license application rule, not school admissions policy
notes: The regulatory wording says after January 1, 2027; school catalog says starting January 1. Preserve wording discrepancy.
State licensing is distinct from the school's Certificate of Completion.
